responsibility: Provides driver and runtime configuration for bare-metal C-SKY ELF targets rather than Linux. It sets startup and termination files, assembler and linker command specs, library selection such as libc, libnosys, libsemi, and optional libcc-rt, passes through target code-generation switches to cc1 and the assembler, enables GNU-source C++ preprocessing behavior, and explicitly disables Linux-only target facilities like POSIX I/O handling.
